summary: I build software for real businesses. Inventory, sales, workshop and scheduling solutions end to end, from the operational problem through to production deployment.
I used to run support, inventory and ERPs; today I use that judgment to build the software the business actually needs.
hero.sceneAlt: elicatari illustration: astronaut panda coding in space

about.title: About me
about.path: I started in graphic design. Curiosity about how everything worked on the inside led me into computing. Today I use both for the same thing: understanding how the business runs and building the software that supports it.
about.mascot: The mascot is Pandiux: panda + UI/UX + GNU/Linux.
about.elibits: Elibits is an easter egg: the alias I use on some projects.
